sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest FII/DII flows, market regime, and breadth details.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_trade_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS trade_date FROM signals.fii_dii_flows)
SELECT flows.trade_date, flows.fii_net_today, flows.fii_net_5d, flows.dii_net_today, flows.dii_net_5d, 
       flows.flow_signal, flows.fii_trend, flows.dii_trend, regime.regime, regime.confidence, 
       breadth.advances, breadth.declines, breadth.trin, breadth.market_sentiment,
       index.close, index.change_pct
FROM signals.fii_dii_flows AS flows
JOIN signals.regime_history AS regime ON flows.trade_date = regime.trade_date
JOIN breadth.market_daily AS breadth ON flows.trade_date = breadth.trade_date
JOIN market.index_eod AS index ON flows.trade_date = index.trade_date
WHERE flows.trade_date = (SELECT trade_date FROM latest_trade_date)
  AND index.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50';

synthesis_guidance: ["Summarize the market's risk-on or risk-off status based on evidence.", 'Provide a narrative synthesis combining flows, regime, breadth, and index actions.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1492
validation_rules: Output must include regime, flow_context, breadth_context, index_confirmation, and risk_flags sections.

sector_ranks.description: Ranks sectors by stage 2 participation and breadth above 50dma.
sector_ranks.template:
WITH latest_sector_data AS (
    SELECT sector, MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    GROUP BY sector
), 
latest_stage_data AS (
    SELECT sector, MAX(snapshot_date) AS latest_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE stage = 'STAGE_2'
    GROUP BY sector
)
SELECT sd.sector, sd.pct_above_50dma, mpa.stage2_pct
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN latest_sector_data lsd ON sd.sector = lsd.sector AND sd.snapshot_date = lsd.latest_date
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above mpa ON sd.snapshot_date = mpa.snapshot_date
ORDER BY mpa.stage2_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Construct a comprehensive view of the sector rotation based on improving breadth and stage analysis.', 'Recommendations should consider relative strength and trading signals.']
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 1497
